name: 33474-moeprefill-30ba3bfp8-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8. Public and ungated; ~31 GB of weights to load at startup.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (SM90) of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, EP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no all-to-all backend. One node, one rank, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM, 30.5B total / ~3.3B active. 48 decoder layers, all MoE: 128 routed experts, top-8, expert width 768, no shared expert. Hidden 2048, 32 query heads over 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, vocab 151936, 40960 native positions. FP8 e4m3 block quantization, weight_block_size [128, 128].
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 1280 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no shared prefix, seed 33474: 2048 prompt tokens in and 32 out, both FIXED (no stdev declared), with `ignore_eos` true and `temperature` 0.0 in `extras.body` so every request generates exactly 32 tokens.
purpose: A document analysis assistant producing brief summaries from long single-turn prompts for 64 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only. A nested block is DROPPED by the flat reader, and the engine then
# starts without the key at rc=0.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8
tp-size: 1
moe-runner-backend: deep_gemm
chunked-prefill-size: 2048
mem-fraction-static: 0.8
disable-radix-cache: true
random-seed: 33474
